text:
ashley: Heads-up: SOC asked for export of auth/event logs to onboard new detection rules. Need guidance: can we give them a one-off SIEM extract for 90d with the ability to pull older forensics artifacts (1y) while preserving retention policy and KMS controls? Also, who owns RBAC changes? :lock:

olga: Short answer: yes, but don't hand out broad S3/list keys. Prefer ephemeral export job + audit trail.

kevin: Agree. Proposal: export-proxy service that streams filtered events to a dedicated bucket encrypted with customer-managed KMS key (alias/sec/siem-exports). Exports tagged with retention-tier header. We issue STS tokens for 'siem-analyst' role with max session 1h.

maria: Compliance: SOC can have 90d query access, but anything >90d needs documented justification + ticket. Forensics >90d should be restricted to incident triage group.

jordan: Operational note: exporter should redact/hash PII before export. Suggest deterministic hashing for IDs so correlation still works. Add field 'pii_masked': true.

ashley: Thanks. Do we have an example policy and CLI to demo this to SOC?

kevin: Yep, sample IAM policy snippet:
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
    "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-exports/*"]
  }]
}
```
But prefer granting 'sts:AssumeRole' to 'siem-analyst' and require 'aws:RequestTag/retention' condition.

jordan: Also add KMS condition: kms:ViaService and kms:EncryptionContext: {"retention":"forensics-1y"} so key grants are scoped.

sec-bot: Policy check: New role 'siem-analyst' flagged for extended retention. Create JIRA SIEM-452 to approve >90d access.

ashley: Created SIEM-452. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SIEM-452 :white_check_mark:

maria: Add audit requirements: every export must include remit ticket id and approver email in metadata and be logged to 'security-audit' index.

kevin: Technical flow: exporter runs query, writes to s3://redwood-siem-exports/incoming/<ts>-<ticket>.ndjson.gz, object metadata: x-retention=90d or forensics-1y; KMS key: alias/sec/siem-exports; lifecycle lambda moves >90d to glacier with encryption intact.

jordan: For immediate queries, allow SOC to query via Splunk forwarder reading from s3 with role 'splunk-reader' limited to prefix 'incoming/'. Splunk access is Read-only and decryption happens via proxy (no direct kms:GenerateDataKey for splunk role).

ashley: One more ask: who approves RBAC changes? Need approver group listed.

maria: Approvers: Security Leadership (olga), Compliance (maria), EngInfra (kevin). Add them to change request.

kevin: I'll draft PR for infra and terraform module for exporter. ETA EOD.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: infra/exporter-service v1.3.2 promoted to staging at 2024-03-31T15:42:10Z

ashley: Copy. Kevin, can you paste the assume-role CLI sample?

kevin: CLI:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/siem-analyst --role-session-name soc-session --duration-seconds 3600 --tags Key=retention,Value=forensics-1y
```

olga: Make sure tickets include 'justification' and 'scope' fields.

ashley: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with SOC to get the justification and mark exports 'audit_ticket=SIEM-452'.

maria: Also record user who triggered export in security-audit and ensure KMS key rotation meets quarterly policy.

ashley: Thanks all. I'll follow up with SOC and post an update here when SIEM-452 is approved.
